scope: Diagnosis of the failed full 2 GiB v18 run; historical host profiling is separate and not a current acceptance benchmark.

implemented_workflow.rewrite_barrier: Rewriting starts only after every analysis task and identity resolution complete.
implemented_workflow.per_record_work: Field policy checks, identity normalization, serialization and encrypted durable evidence; batch storage already exists but cardinality and per-row work remain substantial.

historical_host_profile.source_revision: Not captured; retained diagnostic labelled v18, not current v25 timing.

limits: The full run did not collect a wall-time profile. State growth and memory pressure are observed; their exact contribution to elapsed time is not isolated.
